name: Squadron
description: Spawns and runs its members (entries naming it with +0x11). With a door id it keeps those doors locked until every member is dead. MSR D9 'Squadron entry'. Unnamed bytes are copied 1:1: start from a stock squadron of the same baddy type.

fields.name: stance
fields.description: formation stance (low 2 bits; 2, 3 = alert)

fields.name: count
fields.description: member count (the door unlock checks this many saved flags)

fields.name: behaviour
fields.description: what members do normally: 0x11 (17) smart, walks inside its region to the hero; 9 sentry, never walks and only faces its fixed heading (decomp MSR 'What makes squad members move and turn')

fields.name: alertBehaviour
fields.description: what members do when alerted (the hero seen or heard)

fields.name: hurtBehaviour
fields.description: what members do when hurt

fields.name: size
fields.description: the members' size in hundredths (40 = 0.40, stock ants; 0 = 1.0). It replaces the definition's scale, and every member shares it (decomp MSR 'Phase 2 prep: drawn size and facing') (entry +0x15: member scale, percent)

fields.name: missionChance
fields.description: chance of a special mission on the first sighting beyond 650 units (two 0-50 rolls); a floater's fire chance

fields.name: dodge
fields.description: dodge chance (under 300 units) and morale: the squad retreats when fewer than 100 - this percent of its members are alive

fields.name: aimSpread
fields.description: aim spread: a random yaw of +-(this x 16), half that in pitch

fields.name: offsetX
fields.description: where the squad flies or forms, from the squadron, in units of 16

fields.name: offsetY
fields.description: height of that spot over the squadron, in units of 16 (flyers cruise at y + 16 x this)

fields.name: offsetZ
fields.description: in units of 16

fields.name: triggerX
fields.description: trigger zone centre from the squadron, in units of 16 (trigger 1 and 5)

fields.name: triggerY
fields.description: in units of 16

fields.name: triggerZ
fields.description: in units of 16

fields.name: triggerRadius
fields.description: trigger zone radius, in units of 16

fields.name: triggerHalfHeight
fields.description: the hero's height must be within this x 16 of the zone's centre

fields.name: kind
fields.description: squadron kind (low 4 bits)

fields.name: heading
fields.description: launch / fixed heading

fields.name: launchPitch
fields.description: squadrons that spawn their own members launch them at this pitch (<< 8; positive climbs, -63 straight down)

fields.name: launchSpeed
fields.description: and this speed

fields.name: spawnInterval
fields.description: one member every this x 2 ticks once triggered (0 = all at once)

fields.name: trigger

enum.5: a class-8 object in its zone

fields.description: when the squad spawns (low 4 bits): 1 a hero inside its trigger zone (triggerX/Y/Z, triggerRadius, triggerHalfHeight), 3 at once, 5 an object of class 8 inside the zone, 6 food available; 0, 2 and 4 read stale data

fields.name: missionMin
fields.description: fewest ticks between missions

fields.name: missionMax
fields.description: most ticks between missions

fields.name: modelVariant
fields.description: model variant, for members whose type has more than one

fields.name: squadronId
fields.description: members name it with their +0x11

fields.name: sightRange
fields.description: how far members see, in units of 64

fields.name: viewCone
fields.description: half-width of what they see: +-(this x 91) angle units, about this / 2 degrees

fields.name: hearing
fields.description: the quietest sound event they notice (lower hears more)

fields.name: doorId
fields.description: doors with this id stay locked until the squadron is dead (0 = none)

fields.name: closeRange
fields.description: range of close events, in units of 16

fields.name: closeCone
fields.description: cone of close events: +-(this x 91) angle units

fields.name: health
fields.description: member health in units (8.8 << 8)

fields.name: launchSpread
fields.description: random jitter on each launch velocity component

fields.name: baddyType
fields.description: the member object id (0x78 is an ant)

fields.name: maxSpeed
fields.description: maximum speed

fields.name: minSpeed
fields.description: minimum speed (negative allows reversing)

fields.name: flags
fields.description: 0x40 members go for the hero at once; 0x400 always face the target (bit 3 cleared on load)

fields.name: acceleration
fields.description: acceleration (stock 1, 2 or 8)

fields.name: shotPower
fields.description: shot power - 1 (bolts, spit, beams, missiles; grenades + 10)

fields.name: drop
fields.description: pickup dropped when the last member dies

fields.name: region
fields.description: navigation region (0-127: the game reads it signed); the list must have region corners for it

fields.name: wakeRange
fields.description: members idle while the nearest hero is farther than this (0 = always active)
